transcript:
Customer: Hello? Mera phone kaam nahi kar raha hai, I am very frustrated with this service!
Agent: Welcome to Nimbus Telecom, I am Lucy. How can I help you?
Customer: Listen, mera device completely dead hai. I have tried everything, but it is not turning on. Bahut problem ho rahi hai!
Agent: Tell me your name and phone number.
Customer: My name is Vivek Khan and my number is 99349 80388.
Agent: I see your account. What is the exact issue with the device?
Customer: Screen black hai and charging nahi ho rahi. I paid a lot for this phone, yeh toh bilkul bekar hai!
Agent: Provide your address for the record.
Customer: It is 387 Station Road.
Agent: The device is under warranty, but I cannot fix this over the phone.
Customer: Toh main kya karoon? Please help me, I need my phone for work!
Agent: I am escalating this to the technical hardware team for a deeper look.
Customer: Thank you so much, I am glad you are taking care of it. Shukriya!
Agent: I will book a device check for you at the nearest center.
